name: Karmadeen
source:
Karmadeen – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
An ageless, silver-skinned om’verai with vivid green eyes and a mechanical prosthesis over the left eye. On its crescent-shaped horns hang chained treasures resembling rubies. It is draped in a sky-blue cloak with crimson pauldrons, the cloak also concealing armor plates across the abdomen.
Karmadeen is a ruthless, proud, and ambitious Om’verai who will harm even his allies to achieve his goals. He is a true terrorist whose real objectives remain unknown. Bold enough to defy the commands of his organization’s leader, Karmadin is fearless, manipulative, and fiercely independent—driven by a relentless pursuit of power and influence, regardless of the cost.
